title: The Lord's Promise to Restore the Mountains of Israel
description: The Lord speaks to the mountains of Israel and promises that they will become fertile and inhabited again, while the surrounding nations will bear their shame for having plundered the land. The prophecy promises that the ruins will be rebuilt and that the land will be cultivated and sown once more [ref:Ezekiel 36:1-15|Ezekiel 36:1-15].
